warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: Front brand is set in small capitals with an oversized initial, 'FREISINGER', over 'LAGER'.

The back carries the name twice more: 'FREISINGER' over 'LAGER' at the top in the front's style, and 'FREISINGER LAGERBEER' on one line above the brewer's address, with LAGERBEER closed up as a single word.
The net-contents unit is spelled out as words: '11.2 FL. OUNCES', not FL. OZ. and not a millilitre figure. Neither image carries a metric equivalent, and the back states no quantity at all.
The front's bottom band reads '4.9% ALC. / VOL.' at the left, 'IMPORTED' in the centre and '11.2 FL. OUNCES' at the right; the alcohol wording carries spaces either side of the slash.
Warning is on the back, body fully justified in capitals; the heading 'GOVERNMENT WARNING' is bold capitals followed by a colon in the body weight.
